messages:
Maya: Tiny heads-up — we quietly crossed $1,000,000 ARR this morning. No confetti cannon, promise. :sparkles:
Zane: WHAT 😱 congrats!!!!! Coffee for everyone in the kitchen at 3pm? ☕️
Olivia: I'll bring mini cupcakes. Do we have a no-song policy? last time... 😂
Jordan: No policy. But optional karaoke corner set up by Casey. 🎤
Casey: I am bringing a bluetooth speaker and a kazoo alternative (harmonica). Low-volume samba playlist? :musical_note:
Samir: Love it. For remote folks, we'll Zoom in the 'snack cam'.
chime-bot: Reminder: team lunch budget approved. :receipt: (reaction: :white_check_mark:)
Maya: Also small shoutout to infra crew — zero incidents last week and backlog lowered. Big win. :heart:
Zane: High fives to infra team!! :raised_hands: (reaction: :tada:)
Olivia: Can someone snap a shelfie (office plant + cupcake) for #announcements?
Jordan: I'll take it. Also, I vote for tiny bell instead of kazoo. Gentler. 🔔
Casey: Bell it is. 3pm kitchen. Remote link: https://zoom.us/j/123456789 (placeholder)
Samir: I'll set up camera. Anyone want to volunteer to say a 20-sec toast?
Maya: I'll do a super-quick one. Thanks y'all — quietly but proudly. :tada: (reaction: :confetti_ball:)
